run_train_net: run the TensorMask training script with a config file and optional command line arguments
run_train_net_eval_only: run the TensorMask training script in eval-only mode to test a model on a dataset
build_trainer_evaluator: build a COCOEvaluator for the TensorMask Trainer class to evaluate model inference results
setup_tensor_mask_config: setup the TensorMask configuration by merging a config file and command line options
test_tensor_mask_model: test a TensorMask model by building it, loading weights, and running evaluation
